# Harness

> A Claude Code plugin (meta-skill) that turns a one-line domain description into a
> full agent team and the skills they use, using six architecture patterns. It is a
> Team-Architecture Factory: you describe a domain, and Harness designs the agents,
> writes their skills, and wires up the orchestration.

## Docs
- [README](https://github.com/rafaelrngngroup/harness): full overview, six patterns, benchmark evidence, FAQ.
- [Quickstart](https://github.com/rafaelrngngroup/harness/blob/main/docs/quickstart.md): install and build your first harness.
- [Landing page](https://rafaelrngngroup.github.io/harness/): value proposition and use cases.

## Key facts
- Six architecture patterns: Pipeline, Fan-out/Fan-in, Expert Pool, Producer-Reviewer, Supervisor, Hierarchical Delegation.
- Benchmark: +60% average output quality (49.5 → 79.3), 15/15 win rate, −32% variance (n=15, author-measured A/B on the sister repo `claude-code-harness`; third-party replications pending).
- Runtime: Claude Code (Agent Teams). License: Apache-2.0.
- Core concepts: a *harness* = the pre-configured agent team + skills; an *agent* = who does the work; a *skill* = how the work is done; an *orchestrator* = the top-level skill wiring them into one workflow.

## Related
- Sister repo (benchmark/experiment): https://github.com/revfactory/claude-code-harness
